about: The Workbench icons of the Tunneler drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/tunneler.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: two tanks in their tunnels under the earth) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/tunneler.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. Tunneler-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Tunneler.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Tunneler.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for the other text files.
